summary.headline: Lunar Ingresses and the North Node
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for the Moon’s entry into Virgo through Pisces, covering rulers, people, agriculture, weather, disease, prices, and animals. The eighth chapter begins with the North Node’s entry into Aries and Taurus and its omens for nobles, kings, commanders, food, and social disorder.
